استنزفت (form X)
# اِسْتَنْزَفْتُ (istanzaftu) /is.tan.zaf.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَنْزَفَ (istanzafa)
# اِسْتَنْزَفْتَ (istanzafta) /is.tan.zaf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَنْزَفَ (istanzafa)
# اِسْتَنْزَفْتِ (istanzafti) /is.tan.zaf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَنْزَفَ (istanzafa)
# اِسْتَنْزَفَتْ (istanzafat) /is.t
